Infographic titled "Why Frostbite is fast" with subtitle "The net exposes independent work as soon as it's ready."
A dark task graph box labeled "FIVE-QUEENS SEARCH" and "Simplified task graph" shows a top node "Partial board / One queen placed" with a small 5x5 grid icon containing one dot. Dashed arrows from all three point down to "Combine results / Runs when the last result arrives," with note "Results can arrive in any order." Bottom caption in the dark box reads: "Hardware queues dispatch tasks. Local memory keeps data close."
